team.collaboration: Up to six teammates share one computer and one answer sheet.

execution.wall_clock_note: HS usually 90 minutes / MS 60 minutes; max_turns is a safety budget.
execution.turn_budget_basis: official clock 18 turns vs floor 17 (6 teammates x 2 turns + 1 answer parts + 4 for synthesis)

human_constraints: You must behave like a human teammate under official contest rules.
Do not claim tools, internet, or materials that the rule card forbids.
Do not look up answer keys or hidden solutions.
Up to six teammates may share one computer.
Calculators and computation tools may evaluate expressions; they must not invent the method.
No searching for solution methods or answer keys.
Final answers must be non-negative integers in contest order.
Team size 1–6; adult supervisor required; each team needs its own computer/Internet session (shared computers ⇒ sequential team starts).
MS: 20 problems / 60 minutes; HS: 30 / 90 minutes within a multi-day window (244 hours stated for 2026).
Teamwork encouraged; no help from non-members.
Calculators and computation tools allowed (Desmos, WolframAlpha, Mathematica, GeoGebra, custom code, etc.) for calculations/diagrams only.

May use local books/notes; may NOT use Internet to find solution methods/definitions instruction; may NOT use generative AI (ChatGPT/Gemini/Copilot/Claude etc.) to produce/explain/verify answers or code.
Answers: non-negative integers via web form; last submission per problem counts; remote teammates may communicate.

agent_roles.name: Agent_1
agent_roles.title: captain and answer synthesizer
duties: Maintain the ordered integer answer list.
Submit the final answers only when the sheet is complete.

agent_roles.name: Agent_2
agent_roles.title: algebra and functions specialist
duties: Own algebra, sequences, and functional equations.
Use the calculator only after the method is set.

agent_roles.name: Agent_3
agent_roles.title: geometry specialist
duties: Convert exact results to the required integer answer form.

agent_roles.name: Agent_4
agent_roles.title: counting and probability specialist
duties: Reduce fractions and report m+n style answers carefully.

agent_roles.name: Agent_5
agent_roles.title: number theory specialist
duties: Own number theory and digit problems.

agent_roles.name: Agent_6
agent_roles.title: verifier and calculator operator
duties: Recompute numerical claims with the allowed calculator.
Reject any plan that requires forbidden solution search.

answer_format:
Ordered non-negative integers, one per problem:
1. N
2. N
...
Use the contest's required integer encoding (for example m+n).

scoring.notes: Exact match against the official numeric answer list.

rules_text: Purple Comet! Math Meet team contest: up to 6 students, shared computational tools allowed for calculation only, no AI and no searching for solution methods. Submit non-negative integer answers. Official timing note: HS about 90 minutes / MS about 60 minutes (plus multi-day window historically).

adaptations: only the built-in calculator tool is exposed; CAS/Desmos are not separately instrumented
wall-clock contest windows are represented by a turn budget
